event.title: SFSCON'26 - 'Open and free software meets C2C design' in Bolzano, Italy

body.p: Tim Janßen, co-founder of Cradle to Cradle NGO, will present in this session the Cradle to Cradle Electronics Initiative (C2CEI), to outline how this pre-competitive network of industry leaders, NGOs, and researchers is actively working to establish new standards for circular hardware. This talk demonstrates how software freedom directly extends product lifetimes, improves repairability, and enables continuous innovation across global value chains.
The talk will be in English and it will take place in the Seminar 1.
